name: pandaos-desktop
title: PandaOS desktop (labwc, Wayland)
hints: Desktop: PandaOS with the labwc window manager (Wayland session), a top bar and a dock.
Apps: the text editor is Mousepad, the file manager is PCManFM, the terminal is foot, the web browser is Firefox.
To start an app: press Super (the Windows key) to open the app launcher, type the app name, press Enter. Super+Return opens a terminal.
Windows: alt+Tab switches windows, super+Up maximizes, super+q closes the focused window.
